description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardWithGestureTyping' that extends 'AnySoftKeyboardWithQuickText'. It manages gesture typing features for a custom keyboard, including gesture detection, handling input start and end, loading dictionaries for gesture recognition, and UI watermarking. It also contains inner classes for dictionary loading callbacks and a UI action provider for clearing gestures.

classes.name: WordListDictionaryListener
classes.description: A callback class for loading dictionary words asynchronously, managing loaded words and their frequencies, and providing them to the keyboard for gesture recognition.

classes.name: ClearGestureStripActionProvider
classes.description: A UI component that provides an action button to clear the last gesture, with click handling and visibility control.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes gesture typing feature, sets up reactive subscriptions to power saving and gesture typing preferences, and manages detector setup.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Prepares the input view, adds gesture clear action, and calculates minimum gesture path length based on screen width.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Removes gesture clear action from input view.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Resets gesture-related UI elements.

methods.name: destroyAllDetectors
methods.description: Destroys all gesture detectors and clears related data structures.

methods.name: onAddOnsCriticalChange
methods.description: Handles critical changes by resetting detectors.

methods.name: setupGestureDetector
methods.description: Initializes or retrieves a gesture detector for a given keyboard, and subscribes to its state.

methods.name: onLowMemory
methods.description: Cleans up gesture detectors to free memory.

methods.name: getDictionaryLoadedListener
methods.description: Provides a dictionary loading listener, either for gesture detection or default.

methods.name: onDictionariesLoaded
methods.description: Updates gesture detectors with newly loaded words.

methods.name: onAlphabetKeyboardSet
methods.description: Triggers setup of gesture detector when an alphabet keyboard is set.

methods.name: onSymbolsKeyboardSet
methods.description: Resets gesture detector when a symbols keyboard is set.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInputStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a gesture input, initializing gesture detection.

methods.name: isValidGestureTypingStart
methods.description: Checks if a key is valid for starting a gesture.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInput
methods.description: Adds a point to the current gesture detection.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInputDone
methods.description: Finalizes gesture input, recognizes candidate words, and commits the selected word.

methods.name: generateWatermark
methods.description: Generates watermark icons indicating gesture typing status.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key presses, including confirming gestures and clearing gesture UI.

methods.name: confirmLastGesture
methods.description: Confirms and commits the last performed gesture.

methods.name: pickSuggestionManually
methods.description: Overrides suggestion picking to reset gesture state.
